clip_generation_and_provenance_note: The service distinguishes office-created highlights, viewer-created public clips, and share-a-segment deep links into the original recording.
clip_surface_label: Example clip, highlight, and shareable-segment posture for official voter-information media routes
current_help_recovery_note: When the excerpt is too narrow, stale, or action-changing, the route points back to the current official page, reviewed FAQ/summary, or named office contact instead of relying on clip confidence alone.
delivery_role_note: The service reviews official recordings and attached clip surfaces so public clips, highlights, and shareable segment links remain subordinate to the full recording and the named help lane rather than quietly becoming a shadow portable answer surface.
excerpt_boundary_note: A clip, highlight, or segment link is not automatically treated as a reviewed official portable publication unless the office separately publishes and stands behind that edition.
full_recording_recovery_note: When an excerpt omits qualifiers or correction context, the route points viewers back to the full recording and its surrounding official page context rather than pretending the excerpt is complete.
publicity_and_discovery_note: Portable excerpts may travel through embeds, copied links, discovery surfaces, or public clip shelves and therefore remain subordinate to the full recording and the current written help lane.

reviewed_clip_contexts.context_note: Reviewed shorter media editions the office itself created or published from the original recording.
Reviewed whether viewers could create public clips from the official recording and whether clip titles or circulation could overstate the answer.
Reviewed deep links that open directly to a bounded segment of the original video or replay while preserving recovery to the full recording.
Reviewed channel shelves, discovery routes, or other public excerpt surfaces that could expose the clip before the full recording.
